name: primevue
description: PrimeVue is an open source UI library for Vue featuring a rich set of 80+ components, a theme designer, various theme alternatives such as Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind, premium templates and professional support. In addition, it integrates with PrimeBloc. Latest version: 4.3.9, last published: 8 days ago. Start using primevue in your project by running `npm i primevue`. There are 402 other projects in the npm registry using primevue.
